title: Timeless Mini
blurb: A tiny arena where the clock is your health. Get hit, lose seconds. Win fights, win time back.

title: Orbit Sling
blurb: Circle a planet, tap to let go, and fling yourself to the next one. Real gravity, one thumb.

title: Daily Grid
blurb: One new lights puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Turn every tile off in as few taps as you can.

title: Slime Dash
blurb: A bouncy slime on an endless run. Tap to hop, hold to fly higher, and don't touch the spikes.

title: Gravity Golf
blurb: Mini golf in space. Pull back, aim, and let the planets' gravity curve your shot into the hole.

title: Brick Breaker+
blurb: The classic brick breaker, with real bounce angles, tough bricks and power-ups like multi-ball and lasers.
